title: The JASONs solve DoD problems in summer studies

tellings.quote: They're supposed to solve problems that the DoD gives to them.

plain: The JASONs, a group of top scientists who meet in summer studies to advise the government, are "supposed to solve problems" that the Pentagon hands them, according to Eric W. Davis, a physicist who has worked as a Pentagon contractor. Davis explains this to Michels, and it matters to the show because such a group could be one place secret technical puzzles are taken.
